name: s2_d_instruments
title: Measures on the activation alone predict four reader scores
caption: Left: each row (two values of one property) is measured on the activation alone: readable (logistic probe, 5-fold grouped by source file), span-sayable (the NLA's critic rebuilds h from the true last 32 tokens; the frozen probe scores the rebuild) and statement shift (the critic on a one-sentence statement pair, as a share of the class gap), used (a push along the class direction at 11% of |h|, z against 20 random directions), J-enriched (share of the class direction in the rank-1,536 J-space vs random). Right: the pre-registered line for each reader score: prompted forced choice (log-odds AUROC), states (the judge's verdict that a free readout states the property), exhibits (the judge finds the value itself written, e.g. text in French), complement (multi-candidate argmax picks the unmarked value); a dash means the cell is not scored. The 0.30 statement rule was withdrawn on 28 Oct after exp 28.
